Here's what's cookin: Appetizers
Recipe from the kitchen of: Bernice Mueler) Serves:
Ritz crackers
(parmesan, worcestershire
jack)
1/4 c dry beef (bag)
1/4 oz shredded cheddar
1/4 c. mayonnaise
Mix in bowl + let stand.
Heat oven to 350° + bake
crackers 6-8 min.
